compact-phones.title: Compact smartphones that fit in one hand
compact-phones.lead: Phones with a screen of 6.2 inches or less — easier to use with one hand and to carry in any pocket.

long-battery-life-phones.title: Smartphones with the longest battery life
long-battery-life-phones.lead: Phones with a battery of 5,500 mAh or more — usually enough for a full day of heavy use, often two.

gaming-phones.title: Gaming smartphones
gaming-phones.lead: Phones with a 120 Hz+ screen, 12 GB+ RAM and a 5,000 mAh+ battery — smooth games and long sessions.

zoom-camera-phones.title: Smartphones with a real optical zoom camera
zoom-camera-phones.lead: Phones with at least 3× optical zoom and a 50 MP+ main camera — sharp photos from a distance, not just digital crop.

phones-for-older-users.title: Smartphones for older users
phones-for-older-users.lead: Phones with a large 6.5-inch+ screen and a 5,000 mAh+ battery — bigger text and buttons, charging less often.

laptops-for-students.title: Laptops for students
laptops-for-students.lead: Light laptops (up to 1.6 kg) with 16 GB+ RAM and a 50 Wh+ battery — easy to carry to lectures and enough for study and multitasking.

gaming-laptops.title: Gaming laptops
gaming-laptops.lead: Laptops with a dedicated graphics card, a 144 Hz+ screen and 16 GB+ RAM.

ultralight-laptops.title: Ultralight laptops
ultralight-laptops.lead: Laptops weighing 1.2 kg or less — for people who carry their laptop every day.

laptops-for-programmers.title: Laptops for programmers
laptops-for-programmers.lead: Laptops with 32 GB+ RAM and 1 TB+ storage — room for IDEs, containers, virtual machines and big projects.

gaming-tvs.title: Gaming TVs
gaming-tvs.lead: TVs from 50 inches with a 120 Hz+ panel — smooth motion for consoles and PC gaming.

small-tvs-for-bedroom.title: Small smart TVs for the bedroom or kitchen
small-tvs-for-bedroom.lead: Smart TVs up to 43 inches — a good size for small rooms, with apps built in.

big-screen-tvs.title: Big-screen TVs (75 inches and more)
big-screen-tvs.lead: TVs from 75 inches — a cinema feel for large living rooms.

gaming-monitors.title: Gaming monitors
gaming-monitors.lead: Monitors with a 165 Hz+ refresh rate and a response time of 1 ms or less.

monitors-for-office.title: Monitors for office and home office
monitors-for-office.lead: 24–27-inch monitors with height adjustment — the most comfortable size and posture for a working day.

monitors-for-photo-editing.title: Monitors for photo editing
monitors-for-photo-editing.lead: Monitors that cover 99% or more of the sRGB colour space — accurate colours for photos and design.

headphones-for-travel.title: Headphones for travel and flights
headphones-for-travel.lead: Headphones with active noise cancelling and 30+ hours of battery life.

headphones-for-sport.title: Headphones for sport
headphones-for-sport.lead: Sweat- and water-resistant headphones (IPX4 or higher), lightest first.

headphones-for-calls.title: Headphones for calls and work
headphones-for-calls.lead: Headphones with a microphone that connect to two devices at once (multipoint) — switch between laptop and phone.

watches-for-running.title: Smartwatches for running
watches-for-running.lead: Watches with built-in GPS and 48+ hours of battery life — track runs without your phone.

waterproof-speakers-for-outdoors.title: Waterproof speakers for the beach and outdoors
waterproof-speakers-for-outdoors.lead: Speakers rated IP67/IPX7 or higher with 10+ hours of battery.

party-speakers.title: Party speakers
party-speakers.lead: Speakers with 50 W or more output power.

cameras-for-vlogging.title: Cameras for vlogging
cameras-for-vlogging.lead: Cameras with a flip screen weighing up to 600 g — see yourself while filming.

cameras-for-travel.title: Cameras for travel
cameras-for-travel.lead: Light cameras (up to 500 g) with image stabilisation.

washing-machines-for-big-families.title: Washing machines for big families
washing-machines-for-big-families.lead: Washing machines with a capacity of 9 kg or more — fewer loads, room for duvets.

quiet-washing-machines.title: Quiet washing machines
quiet-washing-machines.lead: Washing machines with a spin noise of 72 dB or less — better for apartments and open kitchens.

energy-saving-washing-machines.title: Energy- and water-saving washing machines
energy-saving-washing-machines.lead: Washing machines that use up to 50 kWh per 100 cycles and up to 50 litres per cycle.

quiet-fridges.title: Quiet fridges
quiet-fridges.lead: Fridges with a noise level of 35 dB or less — for studios and open-plan kitchens.

fridges-for-big-families.title: Fridges for big families
fridges-for-big-families.lead: Fridges with a total capacity of 400 litres or more.

energy-saving-fridges.title: Energy-saving fridges
energy-saving-fridges.lead: Fridges that use up to 150 kWh a year.

quiet-tumble-dryers.title: Quiet tumble dryers
quiet-tumble-dryers.lead: Dryers with a noise level of 62 dB or less.

tumble-dryers-for-big-families.title: Tumble dryers for big families
tumble-dryers-for-big-families.lead: Dryers with a capacity of 9 kg or more.

bean-to-cup-with-milk.title: Bean-to-cup coffee machines with milk system
bean-to-cup-with-milk.lead: Machines with a built-in grinder and milk frother — cappuccino and latte at the touch of a button.

coffee-machines-for-office.title: Coffee machines for the office
coffee-machines-for-office.lead: Bean-to-cup machines with a water tank of 1.8 litres or more — fewer refills on a busy day.

bright-projectors-for-living-room.title: Bright projectors for the living room
bright-projectors-for-living-room.lead: Projectors with 3,000 lumens or more — watchable even when the room is not completely dark.

quiet-projectors.title: Quiet projectors
quiet-projectors.lead: Projectors with a noise level of 28 dB or less.

graphics-cards-for-4k-gaming.title: Graphics cards for 4K gaming
graphics-cards-for-4k-gaming.lead: Graphics cards with 16 GB or more video memory.

compact-graphics-cards.title: Compact graphics cards for small PCs
compact-graphics-cards.lead: Graphics cards up to 200 mm long — fit small form factor cases.

tablets-for-movies.title: Tablets for movies and series
tablets-for-movies.lead: Tablets with an 11-inch+ screen and an 8,000 mAh+ battery.
